jobDescription:
About The Role

Project Role :Custom Software Engineer


Project Role Description :Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
Must have skills :SAP ABAP Cloud

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum



12 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
Build AI native, cloud ready SAP solutions on ABAP Cloud by combining deep ABAP and SAP platform expertise with agentic AI architectures, LLM tooling, and rapid experimentation. The role focuses on designing, implementing, and scaling intelligent SAP applications that integrate ABAP Cloud with LLMs, retrieval pipelines, APIs, and enterprise systemsmoving from automation to autonomy.
This role actively builds AI systems, not just consumes AI tools.

Core Responsibilities
AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.
Implement AI enabled SAP extensions using RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), event driven patterns, and cloud native architectures.
Develop clean, testable ABAP code that integrates seamlessly with AI services and enterprise APIs.
Agentic LLM Integration
Implement agentic workflows:tools, planners, memory, orchestration, and evaluation loops integrated with SAP processes.
Integrate LLMs, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines (RAG) with ABAP Cloud services for contextual, grounded responses.
Design prompt templates, grounding strategies, fallback logic, and safety boundaries suitable for enterprise SAP use cases.
Data, Retrieval Context
Build and integrate retrieval pipelines using SAP and non SAP data sources (business objects, CDS views, documents, events).
Implement chunking, indexing, embeddings, and context assembly to support production grade RAG scenarios.
Ensure factuality, traceability, and explainability in AI driven SAP workflows.
Quality, Safety Reliability
Implement evaluation frameworks (offline and online) for AI behaviors integrated with SAP processes.
Design guardrails for authorization, data privacy, action boundaries, and error handling.
Build observability into AI enabled SAP applications (telemetry, logging, failure analysis).
Rapid Experimentation Scale Out
Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate based on business feedback.
Move AI prototypes into enterprise grade SAP production systems with performance, security, and compliance in mind.
Continuously refine AI behavior, prompts, and orchestration strategies.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP ABAP Cloud (RAP, CDS, OData, clean core principles).
Hands on experience integrating LLMs and AI services into applications.
Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, and contextual retrieval.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (design, testing, CI/CD).
Ability to translate business problems into AI enabled SAP solutions.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Experience with SAP BTP, eventing, APIs, and cloud services.
Familiarity with agent frameworks or custom orchestration logic.
Exposure to vector databases, search, or semantic indexing (SAP native or external).
Knowledge of enterprise security, authorization, and compliance patterns.


Value Delivered
Intelligent SAP applications that reason, retrieve, and act, not just automate.
Faster innovation cycles by embedding AI directly into SAP business logic.
Scalable, secure AI powered SAP extensions aligned with clean core principles.
Foundation for autonomous, AI driven enterprise workflows.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.
Qualification15 years full time education

Summary
Build AI native enterprise applications on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP) by combining strong platform engineering (admin + solution design + full stack build) with agentic AI application patterns (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). This role is about building, deploying, and operating cloud applications on SAP BTP, and evolving them into intelligent systems through rapid prototyping and production hardening.

Core Responsibilities
1) Cloud Application Engineering on SAP BTP
Build, deploy, and manage applications in a cloud-based environment on SAP BTP, covering platform fundamentals, administration touchpoints, solution design, and both frontend and backend development.
2) Full Stack Delivery (Frontend + Backend) with SAP BTP Patterns
Develop backend services and APIs (including CRUD + business logic + validations) using Node.js-based service patterns, and expose services for frontend consumption.
Build responsive UI components using SAPUI5 (XML views, controllers, MVC approach) and integrate with backend APIs for data display and write-back flows.
3) Data Modeling Persistence Foundations
Design database artifacts and data models (tables/views/entities/relationships) and connect applications to SAP HANA-based persistence patterns used in BTP app development scenarios.
4) Platform Setup Deployment Engineering
Configure subaccounts/service instances/roles and set up development spaces configure connectivity artifacts (e.g., destinations) for integrating external APIs and databases as part of application delivery.
Package and deploy applications using multi-target application (MTA) style deployment artifacts where applicable.
5) AI Native Application Patterns (Agentic + LLM Integrated) (Build expectation)
Implement LLM-integrated features as part of BTP applications (e.g., assistant in the workflow ), including:tool calling, orchestration, memory/state handling, and safe action boundaries.
Build retrieval-grounded experiences (RAG-style) over enterprise content and APIs where the solution requires grounded responses, with clear fallback behaviors.
Create evaluation loops (offline test sets + online monitoring) so AI behavior changes are measurable and regressions are caught early.
6) Engineering Excellence (Quality, DevOps, Collaboration)
Use Git-based workflows for source control and collaboration, and operate in Agile/Scrum delivery models.
Debug and resolve backend/database/service exposure issues encountered during full-stack delivery.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP BTP application development fundamentals spanning platform architecture, administration basics, solution design, and frontend/backend build.
Hands-on full-stack implementation patterns evidenced by:backend services + APIs + data models + UI integration.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (clean code, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation) and ability to move from prototype to production (AI native expectation).

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Practical exposure to common BTP app-dev tooling and patterns used in delivery environments (e.g., SAP Business Application Studio usage in full-stack build contexts).
Familiarity with structured learning paths such as BTP Application Development (training listing) and bootcamp-style enablement.
Awareness of platform building blocks and guidelines referenced in community materials like SAP BTP Developer s Guide .

What This Role Does Not Center On
Not limited to AI-assisted development only this role owns AI behavior in the product (orchestration, grounding, evaluation, safety boundaries) as part of delivery (AI native expectation).
Not focused on training foundation models from scratch emphasis is on building agentic applications integrated with enterprise services.

Value Delivered
Rapid delivery of cloud applications on SAP BTP with full-stack rigor (platform + backend + UI + deployment).
Higher-impact solutions by embedding agentic AI capabilities into business workflows while maintaining engineering discipline and operational reliability (AI native expectation).

A 15 years full time education is required

oValidation of order execution and production variances

jobDescription:
About The Role

Project Role :Tech Delivery Subject Matter Expert


Project Role Description :Drive innovative practices into delivery, bring depth of expertise to a delivery engagement. Sought out as experts, enhance Accentures marketplace reputation. Bring emerging ideas to life by shaping Accenture and client strategy. Use deep technical expertise, business acumen and fluid communication skills, work directly with a client in a trusted advisor relationship to gather requirements to analyze, design and/or implement technology best practice business changes.
Must have skills :SAP SuccessFactors Learning

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum

3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
Design, configure, and deliver enterprise SAP SuccessFactors Learning solutions by combining strong learning and talent development domain expertise with AI assisted delivery and integration practices. The role focuses on accelerating implementation, improving learner experience and adoption, and embedding pre built AI and automation capabilities into learning workflowswithout building or training AI models.
Core Responsibilities
Enterprise Learning Delivery
Design, configure, and implement SAP SuccessFactors Learning solutions aligned with organizational learning, compliance, and development strategies.
Translate business, HR, and LD requirements into scalable learning structures, curricula, assignments, and workflows.
Support full lifecycle activities including enhancements, releases, data migration, testing, and production support.
AI Assisted Delivery Productivity
Use AI copilots and GenAI tools to accelerate requirements analysis, content structuring, configuration validation, documentation, and testing.
Apply AI assisted techniques to improve learning recommendations, completion tracking, and operational insights.
Leverage pre built AI capabilities within SAP and adjacent platforms (e.g., intelligent recommendations, automation, insights) to enhance learning outcomes.
Integration Enablement
Integrate SAP SuccessFactors Learning with other SuccessFactors modules and enterprise systems using standard integration patterns.
Collaborate with HR, IT, and analytics teams to ensure consistent learner data and reporting foundations.
Understand AI concepts such as recommendations, automation, and intelligent insights at an applied level, without owning model design.
Stakeholder Collaboration
Partner with LD, HR, compliance, and business stakeholders to align learning solutions with organizational goals.
Communicate complex system and learning concepts clearly to non technical audiences.
Act as a bridge between functional teams and AI native specialists when advanced AI capabilities are required.
Quality, Governance Adoption
Ensure compliance with enterprise SDLC, data privacy, security, and responsible AI guidelines.
Support change management, training, and adoption to maximize learner and administrator engagement.
Drive continuous improvement using feedback, analytics, and AI enabled accelerators.
Primary Skills (Must Have)
SAP SuccessFactors Learning configuration and delivery expertise.
Strong understanding of learning management, compliance, and development processes.
Experience using AI assisted tools or copilots for delivery, analysis, or documentation.
Ability to align learning solutions with business capability and workforce outcomes.
Secondary / Good to Have Skills
Exposure to other SuccessFactors modules (e.g., Employee Central, People Analytics).
Experience with reporting, learning analytics, or content strategy.
Familiarity with change management and large scale learning rollouts.
Working knowledge of automation or intelligent insights in LD contexts.
What This Role Does Not Require
No training or fine tuning of AI/ML models.
No ownership of AI architectures or MLOps pipelines.
Focus remains on integration, adoption, and productivity uplift, not AI engineering.
Value Delivered
Faster SAP SuccessFactors Learning implementations through AI assisted delivery.
Improved learner engagement, compliance, and operational efficiency.
Scalable learning transformation without reliance on scarce AI native talent.

Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required
Qualification15 years full time education

SuccessFactors Expertise

Continuous learning mindset and comfort with AI assisted work.

Experience with automated testing frameworks.

Deliver faster, higher quality SF Onboarding solutions using AI assisted productivity tools.
Improve new hire experience and HR operational efficiency.

A 15 years full time education is required.

About The Role  

Entity:- Accenture Strategy Consulting

Team:- Strategy Consulting Global Network

Practice:- Marketing Analytics

Title:- Consultant/ Manager/Analyst Marketing Customer Data Platforms (GCP, CDP, Agentic AI)

Job location:- Any out of 6 AI locations

About SC - Global Network (GN) :- Accenture GNs Data AI (AI Hub India) practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling to outperform the competition.

WHATS IN IT FOR YOU

As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.

What you would do in this role

A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.



Key Duties and Responsibilities:(GCP CDP)
  • Architect Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Build Production-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability.
  • Model for Insight Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics.
  • Champion DevOps MLOps: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build to automate testing and deployment, manage container images in Artifact Registry, and secure credentials using Google Secret Manager.
  • Deploy Serve: Develop and deploy containerized, serverless APIs (using Docker and Cloud Run) for real-time data ingestion and activation, feeding customer segments and triggers into marketing platforms.
  • Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real-time inference.
  • Collaborate Innovate: Work within a multi-disciplinary team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, prototype new approaches, and provide expert guidance on the art of the possible with GCP and modern data engineering.
  • Ensure Governance Security: Implement solutions that adhere to data governance best practices and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), ensuring data is handled securely and ethically.


    • Key Duties and Responsibilities:(RTCDP)
  • Be a platform expert in Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Real time CDP). Developer level expertise on Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Experience Platform) is a must with other CDP platforms like Lytics, Segment, Amperity, Tealium, Treasure Data etc. including custom build CDPs as an added advantage
  • Deep developer level expertise for real time event tracking for web analytics e.g., Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, etc.
  • Provide deep domain expertise in our clients business and broad knowledge of digital marketing together with a Marketing Strategist industry
  • Deep expert level knowledge of reporting tools like GA360/GA4, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
  • Deep expert level knowledge of paid media destinations - Google Ads, DV360, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, The Trading desk etc.
  • Deep developer expertise for Journey Orchestration and Personalization tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer
  • Assess and audit the current state of a clients marketing technology stack (MarTech) including data infrastructure, ad platforms and data security policies together with a solutions architect.
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews and gather business requirements
  • Translate business requirements into BRDs, CDP customer analytics use cases, structure technical solution
  • Prioritize CDP use cases together with the client.
  • Create a strategic CDP roadmap focused on data driven marketing activation.
  • Work with the Solution Architect to strategize, architect, and document a scalable CDP/Martech implementation, tailored to the clients needs. Able to integrate multiple Martech tools.
  • Ensure analytics are consistently implemented across digital properties. Diagnose and troubleshoot analytics/Martech implementation and platform configuration issues. Perform end-to-end QA testing for integrations.
  • Coordinate with website developers for Analytics integration, datalayer implementation, Martech tools integration
  • Design and Implement Adobe Stack Martech tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics
  • Deep domain expertise in Tag Management, Journey Orchestration, Campaign Management, A/B Testing
  • Perform technical analysis design for Martech related initiatives. Define requirements for Martech implementation/reporting dashboard.


    • Key Duties and Responsibilities:(Agentic AI)
  • Architect the core interaction logic and decision-making frameworks for enterprise-grade, agentic AI systems within marketing on GCP.
  • Leverage Google Agent Development Kit (ADKs) and APIs to orchestrate complex, multi-step agentic workflows, focusing on reasoning capabilities.
  • Design agentic AI systems for scalability, robustness, and real-time responsiveness in autonomous marketing decision-making.
  • Design and implement data storage strategies (Datastores) optimized for efficient retrieval of context for AI agents.
  • Design, implement, and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to equip Gemini agents with contextually relevant information from various knowledge sources.
  • Leverage Gemini models'' reasoning capabilities to enable agents for complex analysis, strategic planning, and problem-solving in marketing contexts.
  • Develop and apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance the reasoning, accuracy, and output quality of AI agents.
  • Implement and leverage grounding evaluation capabilities within Agentic AI systems to ensure outputs are factually accurate, contextually relevant, and traceable to specific data sources for marketing applications.
  • Develop and deploy AI-driven solutions for generating multimodal marketing assets (e.g., personalized images, video snippets, audio messages) powered by Gemini.
  • Implement LLMops best practices for the lifecycle management of agentic AI models, including CI/CD for AI components.
  • Ensure secure and compliant interactions for AI agents, managing credentials and secrets relevant to AI model access.
  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and observability specifically for the performance, decision paths, and output quality of agentic AI systems.
  • Prototype new approaches and provide expert guidance on GCP AI services, Gemini, RAG, advanced prompting, and reasoning AI techniques.
  • Create insights presentations and client-ready decks, effectively communicating findings and recommendations.
  • Mentor and guide junior resources, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.
  • Demonstrate strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively convey complex concepts and insights to stakeholders.
  • Develop strong relationships with clients at all levels, understanding their specific challenges and opportunities.


    • Other roles and responsibilities
  • Business intelligence expertise for insights, actionable recommendations.
  • Project management expertise for sprint planning
  • Provide hands-on support and platform training for our clients.
  • Data processing, data engineer and data schema/models expertise for CDPs to work on data models, unification logic etc.
  • Work with Business Analysts, Data Architects, Technical Architects, DBAs to achieve project objectives - delivery dates, quality objectives etc.


    •  Qualification 

    Who are we looking for
  • B Tech/M Tech from reputed engineering colleges
  • Masters/M Tech in Computer Science
  • Master degree in Statistics/Econometrics/ Economics from reputed institute
  • M.Phil/Ph.D in Statistics/Econometrics or related field
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or software engineering with a data focus.
  • At least 2+ years of demonstrable experience building and managing data solutions on a major cloud platform (GCP is strongly preferred; AWS/Azure experience is valuable)
  • At least 2+ years of relevant work experience in marketing, consulting, or analytics
  • Strong understanding of data governance and compliance (i.e. PII, PHI, GDPR, CCPA)
  • Experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics or Adobe Customer Journey Analytics is a plus.
  • Developer experience with tag management platforms like Adobe Launch/AEP Web SDK, Google Tag Manager, Tealium iQ. Certification in any one is plus
  • Strong understanding of implementation of consent management platforms e.g. Sourcepoint, OneTrust on digital assets
  • Experience in requirement gathering, solution design, tag implementation and audits, Martech tools integration
  • Experience in defining measurement frameworks for websites/app, suggesting KPIs to track, driving strategy for customer engagement
  • Strong experience in ETL, data aggregation and transformation using SQL is a must
  • Experience in mobile analytics implementations is a nice to have
  • Good to have programming experience in PySpark, Python, Shell Scripts.
  • RDBMS, TSQL, NoSQL experience is a plus
  • Manage large volumes of structured and unstructured data, extract clean data to make it amenable for analysis.
  • Experience in deployment and operationalizing the code is an added advantage.
  • Experience with source control systems such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins build and continuous integration tools.
  • Proficient in Excel, MS word, PowerPoint, etc


    • RTCDP (specific skills)
  • At least 2+ years of relevant work experience of implementing CDP solutions with deep understanding of identity resolution methods with minimum 1 year in Adobe RTCDP
  • At least 2+ years of relevant work experience in marketing, consulting, or analytics
  • At least 2+ years of experience working in an agency environment
  • At least 2 years of experience working as Subject matter expert in Adobe Marketing Cloud Stack
  • Experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target is a plus.
  • Experience with Campaign Management tools like Adobe Journey Optimizer or/and Adobe Campaign is a plus.
  • Experience with Adobe Marketing Cloud tools like Adobe Workfront, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), DAM is a plus
  • Experience in Postman APIs is a plus
  • Strong hands-on with advanced JavaScript and jQuery. Able to develop custom tags/scripts using tag managers


    • Agentic AI (specific skills)

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering with a data focus, or AI/ML engineering.
  • At least 2 years of demonstrable experience building and managing data/AI solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Demonstrable experience building and deploying agentic AI systems, leveraging LLMs for complex decision-making.
  • Hands-on experience with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and integrating external knowledge sources for LLMs.
  • Proven ability to apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance LLM reasoning and output quality.
  • Experience working with large language models (LLMs) with a focus on their reasoning capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience working with Google Gemini models and their APIs/SDKs is highly preferred.
  • Experience with multimodal AI concepts is a significant advantage.
  • In-depth, hands-on expertise with core GCP data and AI services, including Vertex AI (for LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG pipeline development).
  • Experience with Vertex AI RAG Engine and GCP datastore.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python is mandatory.
  • Familiarity with frameworks like Agent Development Kit (ADK) for building LLM applications and agentic workflows.
  • Proficient in Terraform, CI/CD practices (Cloud Build), Docker, Artifact Registry, and Google Secret Manager.
  • Experience in deploying and managing AI models in production environments using Vertex AI.
  • Experience integrating with key marketing platform APIs is highly advantageous.
  • Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer (PMLE) certification is highly desired.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical capabilities, particularly in understanding and applying reasoning to complex problems.
  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A proactive, innovative, and results-driven approach.
  • A collaborative spirit and the capacity to mentor and guide junior team members.



    • Technical Skills:
  • Direct experience building or contributing to a custom Customer Data Platform (CDP) or a similar customer-centric data system.
  • Deep GCP ExpertiseHands-on experience with key GCP data servicesBigQuery, BigTable, Vertex AI, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Composer (Airflow), Cloud Functions, Cloud schedular and GKE.
  • DevOps Automation MindsetStrong experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and CI/CD tools (Cloud Build, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Containerization Serverless DeploymentHands-on experience with Docker, managing images in Artifact Registry, and deploying applications to Cloud Run or GKE.
  • MLOps ExperienceFamiliarity with deploying and managing models using Vertex AI (or similar platforms like SageMaker/MLflow) is a strong advantage.
  • Modern Data Stack KnowledgeExperience with tools like dbt (Data Build Tool) for data transformation is a significant plus.
  • Security Best PracticesExperience using tools like Google Secret Manager or HashiCorp Vault to manage application secrets.
  • Marketing Domain AcumenUnderstanding of core marketing concepts like identity resolution, customer segmentation, and audience activation. Experience integrating with marketing platform APIs is highly desirable. Experience with google cloud integration connector is a plus
  • Graph database understanding for solving advance use cases e.g. Identity resolution
  • GA4/GA360, or/and Adobe Analytics, or/and Customer Journey Analytics(CJA)
  • Google Tag Manager, and/or Adobe Launch/AEP Web SDK, and/or Tealium iQ any and/or any Tag Manager Tool - any one (prefer whoever has any one of these)
  • Adobe Journey Optimizer or/and Adobe Campaign
  • Google Ads, DV360, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, The Trading desk etc.
  • Deep Cloud experience (GCP, AWS, Azure)
  • Advance level Python, SQL, Shell Scripting experience
  • Advance level JavaScript /jQuery
  • Data Migration, DevOps, MLOps, Terraform Script programmer
  • Basic HTML
  • Adobe RTCDP (AEP) developer and any other CDP platforms experience e.g., Lytics CDP platform developer, or/and Segment CDP platform developer, or/and Tealium CDP platform developer, or/and Salesforce CDP platform developer, or/and Custom CDP developer on any cloud
  • Adobe Target and/or Optimizely or any personalization or A/B testing tool
  • Adobe Marketing Cloud - Adobe Workfront, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), DAM
  • Experience on debuggers like Adobe Launch debugger, Omnibug, Charles, Browser stack, etc.
  • Experience working and designing Agentic AI systems for complex reasoning and multi-step task.
  • Advance prompt engineering (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, ReAct) to optimize LLM reasoning.
  • Experience on using Agent Development Kit(Adk)
  • Experience working with Multimodal LLMs. Preferably Gemini.

About The Role

Project Role :Custom Software Engineer


Project Role Description :Lead the effort to design, build and configure applications, acting as the primary point of contact.
Must have skills :SAP BTP Datasphere

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum

3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary
Build AI native, data centric products on SAP BTP Datasphere by combining strong enterprise data warehousing and semantic modeling expertise with agentic AI architectures (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). The focus is to move beyond dashboards into intelligent data experiencesdata agents, conversational analytics, and grounded insightsbuilt on governed Datasphere models and integrated enterprise sources.
SAP Datasphere is positioned as a data warehousing solution with integration capabilities.
Core Responsibilities
1) AI Native Data Product Engineering (on Datasphere)
Design and implement governed data products using Datasphere concepts such as Spaces and shareable models/views, enabling teams to explore, transform, and share curated datasets across domains.
Build semantic models that are fit for both analytics and AI consumption (clear entity definitions, measures, hierarchies, lineage-friendly design).
2) Retrieval + Grounding (RAG) over Enterprise Data
Create grounded AI experiences by connecting LLM applications to Datasphere s curated models and enterprise sources (SAP and non SAP), ensuring responses are traceable to governed data.
Engineer retrieval strategies that respect domain boundaries (spaces), freshness needs, and access controls, so AI outputs remain reliable and compliant.
3) Hybrid Modernization Migration (BW bridge patterns)
Enable transition paths from legacy warehouse investments by leveraging approaches such as reusing SAP BW models and skills with Datasphere / BW bridge, supporting phased cloud modernization.
4) Lakehouse style Layering Data Quality by Design
Implement layered design patterns (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold) to land raw data, cleanse/validate, and publish analytics ready modelswhile maintaining clear rules for what s exposed for consumption.
Embed quality controls, validation checks, and reproducible transformations as part of the delivery lifecycle.
5) Agentic Orchestration Tooling
Build data agents that can plan, call tools (query/metadata/lineage), retrieve context, and generate answers with citationsbacked by deterministic checks and fallback behaviors.
Implement prompt templates, tool schemas, and safe action boundaries for enterprise-grade usage.
6) Evaluation, Observability Responsible AI
Establish offline/online evaluation loops (golden questions, regression suites, behavior tests) for conversational analytics and data agents.
Add telemetry for AI interactions (latency, grounding rate, failure modes) to improve reliability and cost efficiency.
7) Integration Collaboration
Partner closely with business, data governance, and platform teams to align data products with real decisions and operational workflows.
Drive reusable patterns and accelerators for repeatable delivery across domains.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP BTP Datasphere:data modeling, spaces, sharing patterns, enterprise semantic design.
Strong data warehousing fundamentals and ability to translate business domains into governed analytical models.
Hands-on building with LLMs + RAG (retrieval, grounding, prompt/tool design, evaluation).
Solid software engineering fundamentals:testability, CI/CD mindset, reliable integrations.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Migration/modernization experience leveraging BW bridge style transition patterns.
Layered architecture implementation (Bronze/Silver/Gold) for scalable analytics delivery.
Familiarity with vector search / embedding pipelines (when integrating external AI retrieval components).

What This Role Does Not Center On
Training foundation models from scratch (the emphasis is on building agentic apps and governed retrieval on enterprise data).
AI assisted only delivery this role owns the AI behavior (grounding, evaluation, safety) end to end.

Value Delivered
Faster path from data to decision through conversational + agentic analytics grounded in governed Datasphere models.
Scalable modernization of hybrid data estates via patterns like BW bridge.
Higher trust AI outputs by implementing layered quality + evaluation loops.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required
Qualification15 years full time education

Job Description
Mathematical Graph Theory Specialist
Overview for Job Profile
As a Mathematical Graph Theory Specialist, you will apply advanced mathematical and graph-theoretical reasoning to interpret and improve the complex graph-based knowledge representations used within the Knowledge Plane. Your role focuses on analysing the structure and behaviour of large-scale knowledge graphsincluding representations of telecom domain structures and other system contextsto identify patterns, dependencies, motifs, and emergent properties. You will determine how these knowledge representations should evolve or be refined for more effective reasoning and decision support. Working with TRAM Entities, you will apply deep mathematical reasoning to structured graph knowledge and contribute graph-theoretical insights into autonomous decision-making and support the evolution of autonomous network.
Responsibilities
  • Interpret and analyse large-scale graph-based knowledge representations, including models of telecom domain structures and other system contexts, using advanced mathematical and graph-theoretical methods to identify patterns, dependencies, motifs, anomalies, and emergent behaviours.
  • Apply deep mathematical graph theory to deliver structural reasoning that goes beyond metric-level graph analysis, using those metrics as complementary inputs while explaining why behaviours arise and determining how knowledge representations should evolve or be refined for more effective reasoning and decision support.
  • Represent information as structured graph knowledge through appropriate abstractions, ontologies, and semantic modelling techniques.
  • Reason about state, constraints, and relationships across telecom and system domains using structural, spectral, probabilistic, and combinatorial graph concepts.
  • Drive the development and evolution of the Knowledge Plane essential for achieving Autonomous Network capabilities.
  • Work with TRAM Entities to embed graph-theoretical reasoning into analysis and decision-making workflows to achieve their respective autonomous network goals.

The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in optimizing MongoDB sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support operational processes, and drive business growth.

With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Salesforce Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable CRM solutions that support MongoDBs Sales organization. This role combines strong hands-on Salesforce development, solution design, cross-functional collaboration, and a modern engineering mindset to deliver reliable, maintainable, and high-quality solutions across the core Salesforce platform.

What youll do
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions across the core CRM platform, including custom development, automation, and integrations
  • Partner with business stakeholders, program managers, and technical teams to understand requirements and translate them into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions
  • Own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support
  • Collaborate closely with globally distributed engineering teams to deliver reliable, secure, and well-governed solutions in an Agile environment
  • Drive strong engineering practices across code quality, documentation, release management, and platform governance
  • Identify opportunities to improve system performance, simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, and strengthen the overall Salesforce operating model
  • Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and deliver sustainable, long-term fixes
  • Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, engineering best practices, and emerging technologies, and apply them thoughtfully to improve delivery quality
  • Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Agentforce, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar capabilities to improve productivity, code quality, troubleshooting and documentation, while using sound judgment around security, privacy, and responsible AI usage
Responsibilities
  • Develop, test, document, and deploy high-quality Salesforce solutions aligned with business needs and engineering best practices
  • Support enhancements, break/fix issues, and ongoing maintenance across Salesforce applications and related integrations
  • Investigate technical and integration issues and work closely with development, operations, admin, and business teams to resolve them effectively
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates on delivery status, technical challenges, and solution options
  • Manage multiple priorities effectively while ensuring high-quality and timely delivery
  • Research new platform capabilities, prototypes, and engineering approaches that can improve the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and administrators where needed
  • Build strong working relationships across teams and contribute positively to a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

  • Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), JavaScript, Flows, SOQL, APIs, and Salesforce platform customization

  • In 3 months, you will: Develop a strong understanding of MongoDBs Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, and current implementations by working closely with senior engineers and stakeholders

PS Functional Technical Delivery

Networks, Activities Activity Types

Integration with Procurement, Finance, and Controlling

Documentation creation (FS/TS/SOPs)

Requirement summarization and project scope analysis

Predictive budget risks or schedule delays
Automated summarization of project performance and deviations

Use LLM assisted troubleshooting to reduce incident resolution time for settlement errors, network failures, or planning inconsistencies.

Participate in workshops, walkthroughs, and project review meetings supported by AI generated insights.
Collaborate with project managers, finance controllers, procurement, engineering, and integration teams.
Contribute to reusable templates, test packs, configuration guidelines, and AI enhanced best practices.

SAP PS Expertise
Hands on experience with WBS, network activities, cost planning, budgeting, progress analysis, settlements, and reporting.
Understanding of PS FI/CO integration, commitments, cost flows, and procurement triggers (PR/PO from projects).

Bangalore, Karnataka, India
We are looking for highly skilled professionals with Robust hands-on and architectural expertise in Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and the Power Platform.   • Bachelors degree in commerce or science.

  • Relevant years of experience with effective analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Robust architectural knowledge of Microsoft Fabric.

  • Advanced skills in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, performance optimization)
  • Relevant experience with the Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate).
  • Solid expertise in SQL and data modeling concepts.
  • Experience working in cloud environments, particularly Microsoft Azure.
  • Exposure to Azure Databricks and modern data engineering patterns.

Desired Skills and Abilities:

  • DP600 / DP700 Microsoft certifications.
  • Working knowledge or exposure to Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI concepts.
  • Ability to understand and contribute to AI-driven analytics use cases is a plus.

Collaborate with UX, integration, data, and platform teams to ensure end to end solution correctness and performance.
Prototype rapidly, demonstrate frequently, and evolve prototypes into scalable production systems with security and compliance baked in.

AI assisted only development this role builds and owns AI behaviors (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability) as part of SAP solution delivery.

jobDescription:
Role Summary

  • This opening is for Antier's AI Department. This is not a coordination role. We're hiring a senior delivery owner who acts as the right hand to the department lead - someone who takes full end-to-end accountability for project delivery, requirements, client relationships, and revenue growth on their accounts.
  • The ideal candidate combines proven Project Management discipline (planning, tracking, delivery) with strong Business Analyst instincts (spotting edge cases, unstated requirements, and risks before they surface), plus the client-facing confidence to run sales calls and convert them into upsell opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Ownership

  • Own end-to-end delivery of assigned projects - planning, execution, tracking, and closure - with full accountability for outcomes, not just status updates.
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and edge cases before they become blockers; anticipate problems the client or team hasn''t raised yet.
  • Drive resolution of delivery issues independently, escalating only when necessary.
  • Own the P&L for assigned accounts - track project profitability, effort vs. billing, and margin against the original SOW estimate.

Business Analysis

  • Gather, structure, and validate requirements directly with clients - translating ambiguous asks into clear scope, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Produce and maintain SOWs, BRDs, process flows, and other delivery documentation.

Must-Have Skills, Experience and Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent PM/BA-focused postgraduate qualification is a plus.
  • 3+ years of experience in Project Management in IT/software services.
  • Prior experience delivering AI or other emerging-tech projects is a strong plus.
  • Must be able to understand AI solution concepts, architecture and constraints well enough to independently spot technical edge cases and translate between clients and delivery teams
  • Experience leading or mentoring a small team (junior PMs/BAs or coordinators).
  • Hands-on experience owning project P&L - tracking margin, effort vs. billing, and cost overruns.
  • Working knowledge of PM/documentation tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy and full accountability for outcomes.

Nice-to-Have

  • PMP, CSM/PSM, CBAP/CCBA or equivalent PM/BA certification.
  • Hands-on technical background (development, QA, or architecture) prior to moving into PM/BA work.
  • Experience with international/enterprise clients across time zones.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership does not need to chase status - updates and risks are surfaced proactively.
  • Clients treat this person as a trusted advisor, not a ticket-router.
  • Accounts under their ownership show measurable upsell growth over time
  • Documentation is complete and audit-ready at every stage without being asked.
  • Delivery SLAs and milestone commitments are consistently met or proactively renegotiated ahead of time.
  • Account-level margins hold at or above target, with no unbilled scope creep going unnoticed.

Location - Mumbai, Delhi / NCR, Bengaluru , Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune,

Job Title Resilient Sustainable Value Chain Team (RSVC) Consultant - SC GN-SP

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you believe in creating an impact for a sustainable futureAre you a problem solver who enjoys working on transformative strategies for global clientsAre you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

Then, this is the right place for you!

Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Strategy and Consulting.

The Practice- A Brief Sketch:

The Resilient Sustainable Value Chain Practice is a part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting and enables greater resiliency, sustainability and efficiency with end-to-end capabilities. We help organizations embed sustainability into every aspect of their supply chain to enable them to unlock greater value through responsible transformations.

We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in Sustainable Value Chain, where you will get an opportunity to advise and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. We also work with global organizations such as theWorld Economic Forum, theUnited Nations Global CompactandWorld Business Council for Sustainable Development. As a part of this high performing team, these are some of the areas you will consult clients on:

  • Resilient Supply Chain Strategy: Work closely with clients to assess vulnerabilities across their value chains and co-develop end-to-end resilience and sustainability strategies tailored to their business context.
  • Sustainable Value Creation: Help clients build supply chain operating models that are economically efficient while embedding environmental and social responsibility across procurement, operations, and logistics.
  • Supply Chain Transformation Road-Maps: Develop implementation road maps for resilient and sustainable supply chains, leveraging data-driven insights across themes such as circular economy, supply chain decarbonization, traceability, and responsible sourcing.
  • Industry Partner Alliances: Work with notable organizations like UN, WEF, FICCI and prominent business leaders to shape sustainable business agendas.

  • Supply Chain Decarbonization: Develop a deep understanding of Scope 3 emissions, low-carbon logistics, and supplier decarbonization strategies, and drive meaningful conversations around net zero transition across value chains.
  • Circular Traceable Supply Chains: Design go-to-market and entry strategies for clients embedding circularity, traceability, and regulatory compliance (EUDR, CSDDD, DPP) into their supply chain and product strategies.
  • Technology-Enabled Supply Chains: Work with clients to assess the digital maturity and environmental footprint of their supply chain technology landscape and recommend strategies leveraging AI, platforms, and data to drive efficiency and sustainability.

What are we looking for Must have skillset!

  • MBA from a tier 1 institute with 3-8 years of (post-MBA) work experience in consulting or related fields (preferrable)
  • Strategic Consulting Mindset - Ability to work on complex client problems and recommend innovative approaches and solutions
  • Skillset to analyse large amounts of qualitative and quantitative data to draw insights and trends
  • Structured problem solving and strong analytical skills
  • Ability to present the recommendations in a compelling narrative through client ready deliverables.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to leverage that to for project delivery and stakeholder management
  • Building on relationships with potential and existing clients and be responsible for business development in assigned areas
  • Potential to work with diverse teams and to be able to foster learning, exchange and innovation
  • Grasp of MS power point, Excel and Word is important. Other tools like Power BI, Tableau is a plus
  • Build analytical use cases in AI/ML/Gen AI across different functions
  • Ability to work with large data sets and present findings / insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL, Oracle, S3 buckets and likes of the same
  • Development, and deployment of sophisticated AI agents and multi-modal AI solutions that can autonomously execute complex business workflows. in supply chain and sustainability contexts

We are hiring across multiple roles! Experience in one or more categories listed below will be preferred.

What are we looking for Good to have!

AREA 1: RISK RESILIENCE

  • Experience in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) including supplier risk assessments, risk scoring frameworks, and sustainability-linked due diligence
  • Hands-on experience with N-tier visibility tools and scenario simulation
  • Ability to design and implement supplier risk monitoring frameworks, including financial, operational, and ESG-linked risk indicators
  • Experience conducting supply chain risk mapping identifying single points of failure, geographic concentration risks, and supplier dependency analysis
  • Ability to develop risk mitigation roadmaps and resilience strategies that integrate sustainability considerations across supply chains
  • Experience working with risk and resilience platforms such as Osapiens, Interos, or ProcessUnity

OR

AREA 2: TRACEABILITY

  • Strong understanding of traceability regulations and standards including EUDR, CSDDD, PPWR, Digital Product Passport (DPP), and GS1 standards
  • Exposure to sector-specific compliance requirements (e.g., batteries, textiles, electronics, industrial products) and their associated data and reporting obligations
  • Experience designing and implementing traceability and transparency solutions across complex, multi-tier supply chains
  • Familiarity with Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), product-level carbon footprint methodologies, and Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) approaches
  • Knowledge of regulatory landscape including product compliance frameworks (EU Taxonomy, CBAM)
  • Experience with ESG data and technology architecture for traceability use cases
  • Ability to gather business requirements, identify platform fits and gaps, and develop functional specifications for traceability and sustainability reporting use cases
  • Ability to interpret complex, multi-source data sets and map data elements across systems, value chain steps, and stakeholders

OR

AREA 3: CIRCULAR SUPPLY CHAINS

  • Strong experience working on circular economy projects across thematic areas such as plastic packaging, e-waste, textiles
  • Experience designing circular transformation strategies across supply chains including reverse logistics, take-back model design, and material flow analysis
  • Knowledge of technology enablement and service plays that support circularity including digital platforms (e.g. Agora) for tracking material flows and closed-loop systems
  • Understanding of circular strategy and business model design, including circular operating model design and sustainable product portfolio steering
  • Experience with supplier assessments and engagements using tools such as EcoVadis

OR

AREA 4: SUPPLY CHAIN DECARBONIZATION

  • Strong experience in supplier decarbonization managed programs including supplier engagement onboarding, emissions baselining, and decarbonization roadmap development
  • Experience with science-based target setting (SBTi) and delivering science-based targets as a service
  • Deep understanding of Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions accounting, carbon neutrality strategies, and low-carbon energy transition across key geographies (US, EU, India, Australia)
  • Strong experience working on clean energy projects including onsite/offsite Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs), and carbon offsets
  • Experience with ESG reporting frameworks and sustainability data platforms (SAP, Workiva, Enablon, Oracle, MSM) for carbon and climate disclosure use cases
  • Understanding of ESG Intelligence capabilities including gap assessment vs ESG frameworks, GenAI-powered sustainability report generation, and end-to-end ESG platform implementation




Qualification

Educational Qualification: MBA

  • Stay current with the rapidly evolving LLM ecosystem and proactively propose improvements and new approaches.
  • Contribute to internal best practices, documentation, and knowledge-sharing across the engineering org.

Required Qualifications


Experience

  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years focused on

LLM/AI systems.

  • Proven experience shipping LLM-based products or agentic AI systems into production environments.

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with async programming patterns for AI pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs: OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), or open-source models (Llama, Mistral).
  • Experience with agentic frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar.

  • Experience with vector databases and similarity search infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of REST APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).

Problem-Solving & Mindset

  • Strong ability to decompose ambiguous, open-ended problems into structured AI system designs.
  • Experience with prompt debugging, LLM evaluation, and iterative refinement workflows.
  • Ability to balance research exploration with engineering pragmatism to ship reliable systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration and agent memory systems (short-term and longterm).
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning or RLHF workflows for domain adaptation.
  • Background in NLP, information retrieval, or conversational AI.
  • Prior experience in B2B SaaS or CRM domain is a plus.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or published research/blogs.
  • Experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure — particularly AI/ML services.

title: Associate Business Development Manager
tagsAndSkills: Co-sell,International Sales,Microsoft Partner Ecosystem,Solution Sales,Data & AI Sales,Strategic Alliances,Proposal Writing,Microsoft Sales
jobDescription:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Associate Client Engagement Manager works alongside the senior Client Engagement Manager to drive Celebal's commercial and client engagement activity across the GCC primarily Saudi Arabia and the UAE — with a clear path to owning accounts and transactions outright.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, but it is not a coordination role. You will be expected to hold your own in a first conversation with a Microsoft solution specialist or a client stakeholder without a technical colleague on the call, to explain what Celebal does differently in a specific solution area, and to build and defend a commercial estimate. Pre-sales, delivery and practice teams support you; they do not substitute for you.

Read this before applying: the interview includes a live technical and commercial assessment. Candidates who position themselves as functional or relationship-only sellers, and who require pre-sales support for every solution conversation, are not a fit for this role — regardless of years of experience or account pedigree.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Pipeline Ownership & Deal Progression

  • Own and progress a defined slice of the GCC opportunity pipeline — from qualification through proposal submission, negotiation support and closure — with the senior CEM as escalation point rather than as approver of every step.
  • Run RFP, RFI and tender responses end to end: interpret requirements, decompose the scope, own the response plan and timeline, drive contributions from pre-sales and practice leads, and assemble a submission that is compliant and commercially sound.
  • Manage Microsoft and partner co-sell motions directly — deal registration, co-sell submissions, MCI/ECIF and pre-sales funding nominations, and joint account planning with Microsoft SSPs, ATUs and partner leads (Crayon and others).
  • Maintain CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy and pipeline reporting to a standard that leadership can act on without rework.
  • Schedule and lead client meetings, demos and technical presentations; author the meeting narrative and the follow-up MOM, not just the logistics.

2. Client Engagement & Account Ownership

  • Act as a named point of contact for assigned accounts, holding day-to-day commercial and delivery-liaison conversations independently.
  • Produce client-facing material — proposals, BoQ and BoM summaries, executive briefings, project status narratives — in a form that goes to the client with light review, not heavy rewriting.
  • Track milestone status with delivery, trigger milestone-linked commercial actions, and own invoicing follow-up, collections escalation and revenue realisation for your accounts.
  • Maintain complete, auditable engagement documentation: MSAs, SOWs, Change Requests, LOIs, correspondence and approval trails.

3. Solution Positioning & Differentiation

  • Articulate what Celebal does differently in specific solution areas — Microsoft Fabric and Databricks-based data platform modernisation, migration accelerators, GenAI and agentic use cases, sovereign cloud and security — and why that beats an incumbent system integrator. This is a core competency of the role, not a marketing hand-off.
  • Maintain and actively use the GCC solution narrative: capability decks, reference architectures, case studies, industry-specific use-case libraries and competitive positioning.
  • Translate a client problem statement into an indicative solution shape and commercial envelope in the room, then validate it with pre-sales — rather than deferring the entire conversation.

4. Proposal, Estimation & Commercial Construction

  • Author the executive summary, scope of work, assumptions, exclusions and commercial sections of proposals; source tech stack, effort estimates and delivery timelines from pre-sales and delivery and integrate them coherently.
  • Build and adjust Azure consumption estimates independently using the Azure pricing calculator — storage, compute, capacity SKUs and licensing — and understand how those choices move the client's total cost.
  • Draft quotations, SOW summaries and Change Request documentation; understand the difference between T&M, fixed-price, managed-capacity and outcome-based structures and when each is appropriate.

5. Internal Coordination & Governance

  • Liaise with delivery, legal, finance and HR on engagement onboarding, commercial issue resolution and contract execution.
  • Prepare internal briefing notes, commercial summaries, deal review packs and escalation memos of a standard suitable for regional leadership review.
  • Contribute to WBS updates, revenue forecasting and weekly/monthly business reviews.
  • Ensure clean account handovers with full context and documentation captured.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Essential — screened against, no exceptions

  • GCC market experience. 4–6 years in B2B technology sales, client engagement, pre-sales or account management, including demonstrable UAE and/or KSA market experience — in-market work history, or documented ownership of GCC-based client relationships. Regional exposure gained purely through remote channel coordination does not meet this requirement.
  • Microsoft partner ecosystem depth. Hands-on experience with co-sell motions, deal registration, and pre-sales or partner funding mechanisms (MCI, ECIF or equivalent), including working relationships with Microsoft field roles (SSP, ATU, partner development).
  • Data & AI portfolio literacy. Working knowledge of the Microsoft data and AI stack — Azure data services, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, GenAI/Copilot patterns — sufficient to scope a data platform, migration or AI use-case conversation unaided.
  • Cloud and security fundamentals. Practical fluency in Azure architecture basics, M365/O365, and Microsoft security and compliance (Sentinel, Defender, identity). Certification at fundamentals level or above (AZ-900, MS-900, SC-900, DP-900 or higher) is expected; equivalent demonstrated knowledge is acceptable.
  • Estimation capability. Able to build and defend an Azure consumption estimate on the Azure pricing calculator without pre-sales assistance. This is tested live during interview.
  • RFP and tender ownership. Direct experience running or substantially owning RFP, RFI or government tender responses, including compliance and commercial sections.
  • Services-commercial exposure. Familiarity with MSAs, SOWs and Change Requests, and with authoring scope and commercial terms for services engagements — as distinct from licensing or product resale.
  • Deal scale. Experience on engagements where individual proof-of-concept values reach USD 150K or above and multi-year programmes exceed USD 1M. Celebal proof-of-concept engagements alone routinely run USD 200K–250K.
  • Applied AI fluency. Uses AI tooling deliberately in the sales craft — research, account intelligence, first-draft proposal and RFP response construction, competitive analysis — with judgement about what must still be authored and verified by a human.
  • Communication. Clear, professional written and spoken English; able to produce client-ready correspondence and documents with minimal supervision.
  • Education. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. MBA or a technical postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  • Mobility. Based in or willing to relocate to Dubai, with a valid ability to travel across KSA and the GCC.

Preferred

  • Arabic language capability.
  • Prior employment with a Microsoft partner, system integrator or technology consulting firm serving enterprise clients in the region.
  • Account experience in logistics, government or public sector, FMCG, or financial services in the GCC.
  • Exposure to sovereign cloud, data residency or regional compliance requirements (SDAIA, NDMO, UAE data protection).
  • Experience with CRM and revenue tooling — Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clari.
  • Familiarity with government procurement portals and tender platforms in KSA or the UAE.

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical credibility. Can hold a solution conversation with an architect or Microsoft specialist and be taken seriously. This is the single most important competency in the role.
  • Commercial judgement. Understands deal structures, pricing models, margin implications and revenue recognition well enough to shape a deal, not just document it.
  • Independent ownership. Moves an opportunity forward without waiting to be told the next step; escalates with a recommendation attached.
  • Competitive framing. Can explain why Celebal, in a specific solution area, against a specific incumbent, in under two minutes.
  • Organisational rigour. Manages concurrent engagements with accurate documentation, clean CRM and reliable follow-through.
  • Stakeholder navigation. Comfortable across pre-sales, delivery, legal and finance internally, and across client procurement, IT and business stakeholders externally.
  • Cross-cultural effectiveness. Operates credibly in GCC business culture and with distributed India-based delivery teams.
  • Adaptability. Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth regional business with evolving priorities.

SELECTION PROCESS

Candidates should expect a structured assessment rather than a conversational interview. The process comprises an HR screening, a technical and commercial round with sales leadership, and a regional fit discussion.

What we assess


How

Solution positioning


You will be asked to pitch Celebal cold to a Microsoft SSP covering a named industry, and to answer why a client should move work to us from an incumbent SI. Generic value statements do not clear this stage.

Commercial sizing


You will be asked to open the Azure pricing calculator on screen and build or adjust a simple estimate — storage, compute, capacity SKU — without pre-sales support.

Solution depth


You will be asked to walk through the most technically complex engagement you have sold, including data sources, integration approach and platform choices, in your own words.

Commercial structure


You will be asked how a proposal is assembled — which sections you author, which you source from pre-sales and delivery, and how pricing model and timelines are arrived at.


CAREER PATH

This role is a structured route into a full Client Engagement Manager position. Candidates who demonstrate technical credibility, commercial judgement and independent account ownership will be considered for progression within 18–24 months. Progression is assessed on independent deal ownership and solution credibility, not tenure.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
  • Direct exposure to marquee enterprise and government accounts across the GCC.
  • Close collaboration with Microsoft field and product teams, including global initiative and sovereign cloud programmes.
  • Structured mentorship from experienced regional sales leadership.
  • Funded certification pathways across Azure, Data & AI, and Security.
  • Fast-track growth in a priority geography, within a global team spanning the Americas, EMEA, India, APJ, Australia and Japan.

To apply or for queries, please contact: chaity.mukherjee@celebaltech.com

  • Ability to work directly with customers, engineers, and business leadership.

Customer Problem >> AI & Workflow Design >> Product Experience >> Architecture >> Implementation >> Production Value

Job Description - Project Manager


As a TaskUs Project Manager, you will be the architect and catalyst of AI-integrated project delivery and operational transformation. Your mission is to transcend traditional project road mapping by driving human-AI collaboration, deep process mapping, and technology-driven problem solving to accelerate client implementations and internal digital transformations.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent business/project management experience.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with teams across different geographies, manage cross-functional teams respectfully, and report to cross-geo managers.
  • A solution-oriented mindset, comfortable with change and evolving business needs.
  • Openness to working in multiple time zones, usually aligning with client or project team’s working hours.
  • Demonstrated understanding of core generative AI principles and their practical application in project planning, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven ability to craft clear, specific, and effective prompts to guide AI tools in generating accurate and useful outputs, such as drafting summaries, creating content, or refining ideas.
  • Proactive AI & Tech Passion: Demonstrated passion and a proactive track record of experimenting with, deploying, or driving technology and AI-driven solutions to solve real-world business problems.
  • Process Mapping Capability: Proven ability to map complex operational process flows, identify inefficiencies, and design optimized workflows.
  • Executive Presentation Skills: Ability to articulate complex operational workflows and pitch tech/AI concepts clearly to senior C-suite client stakeholders.
  • Shift Flexibility: Willingness and open availability to work US operational hours / night shifts as needed to align with global account demands.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • BPO experience
  • PMP, Agile, and/or Lean Six Sigma certifications
  • Google Workspace with Gemini feature set (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet, Gmail) and experience leveraging these or other AI tools to accelerate project workflows and content creation.
  • Experience with international vendor management and launching new sites or geographies.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based systems (8x8, Aircall, Five9, Salesforce, Zendesk, Smartsheet, G Suite).
  • Process Mapping Tools: Experience with process mapping and workflow visualization tools (e.g., Sirocco Scout, Visio, Lucidchart, Celonis, or similar).

About TaskUs

TaskUs is a leading provider of next-generation customer experience, driving innovation for the world’s most disruptive companies. We combine top-tier talent with cutting-edge technology to deliver scalable, transformative solutions. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, fostering a culture of excellence and making us one of the "Best Places to Work."

TaskUs has been recognized on multiple industry lists, including the Inc. 5,000 Fastest Growing Private Companies and Los Angeles Business Journal’s 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies.

jobDescription:
About the Role


We believe great user experiences begin with understanding business problems before designing solutions. We are looking for a proactive, analytical professional who enjoys engaging with diverse stakeholder groups, simplifying complexity and translating ideas into practical, user-centred digital solutions.

As part of our Product & Business Experience practice, you will independently own UX solutioning activities across assigned client engagements with minimal supervision. Our work spans enterprise applications, corporate websites, digital platforms, data portals and product initiatives, requiring the ability to adapt to diverse business domains and project types. You will lead discovery, facilitate stakeholder discussions, define solution direction, guide visual designers and collaborate closely with engineering teams to deliver solutions that balance business goals, user needs and technical feasibility.

AI is an integral part of how we work. We expect leads to actively leverage AI for research, ideation, conceptualisation, solution exploration, documentation, wireframing, prototyping and delivery, while continuously evaluating emerging AI capabilities.


Key Responsibilities


Business Discovery & Solutioning

  • Independently lead discovery workshops to understand business objectives, user needs and operational challenges.
  • Bring together diverse stakeholder groups to build a shared understanding of business problems and solution direction.
  • Analyse business processes and translate discussions into clear requirements, decisions and actionable next steps.
  • Help establish realistic scope and priorities while balancing business goals, user experience and engineering feasibility.

Experience Design

  • Translate business problems into intuitive digital experiences across a variety of project types.
  • Define experience direction through user journeys, workflows, information architecture, conceptual wireframes and interactive prototypes.
  • Provide functional guidance to visual designers while preserving business intent, usability and technical feasibility.

Stakeholder Facilitation

  • Confidently engage business users, SMEs, engineering teams, project managers and leadership.
  • Facilitate discussions, build consensus and constructively challenge assumptions where appropriate.
  • Own the UX solutioning workstream for assigned projects while collaborating with practice leadership on larger strategic initiatives.

Delivery Excellence

  • Support engineering teams during implementation to ensure the intended experience is realised.
  • Contribute reusable UX assets, templates and design patterns, and actively share project learnings to strengthen the practice.
  • Continuously improve delivery quality through structured thinking and knowledge sharing.

AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Use AI daily for research, ideation, conceptualisation, documentation, wireframing, prototyping and productivity.
  • Stay current with emerging AI capabilities, including agentic workflows where appropriate, and evaluate how they can improve delivery.

What We're Looking For

  • 48 years of experience delivering UX solutions for enterprise applications, websites, portals, digital products or similar digital initiatives.
  • Strong business analysis, solutioning and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently own assigned projects while recognising when to seek guidance.
  • Proven ability to engage, influence and build consensus across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Ability to balance business goals, user needs and engineering feasibility.
  • Strong communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of Figma or similar tools for conceptualisation and wireframing.
  • Good appreciation of visual design with the ability to guide visual designers.
  • Comfortable using AI as a core part of everyday work and keen to adopt emerging AI capabilities.
  • Proactive, self-motivated and committed to continuous learning.

AI Evaluation & Observability
