Youll report to our Associate Director of Growth Marketing and work closely with sales, running live campaigns and making rapid optimization decisions based on pipeline metrics.

This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Youll set budget allocation strategy, design account-based campaigns, analyze cohort performance, and recommend channel-mix decisions, then run those campaigns day to day.

Your Core Responsibilities

Account-Based Marketing (ABM) & LinkedIn

  1. Design and execute ABM campaigns: Build target account lists (TALs) based on fit and intent signals; create audience segments in LinkedIn Campaign Manager; manage creative, messaging, and landing pages aligned to account-level campaigns.
  2. Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator strategically: Research decision-makers, build targeted outreach sequences, and feed warm leads into campaigns. Coordinate with sales on account selection and timing.
  3. Test and optimize ABM tactics: Run A/B tests on account segments, messaging, ad formats, and landing page experiences. Track cohort performance (account reach, engagement rates, MQL/SAL conversion by account segment).
  4. Own ABM budget and ROI: Decide spend allocation across ABM tiers (named accounts, lookalike, account cluster campaigns); track CAC and pipeline ROI by campaign.
  5. Coordinate account strategy with sales: Share campaign performance, account engagement data, and recommendations with AEs; collaborate on account prioritization and timing.

Paid Media Mix

  1. Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max): Manage campaigns, keyword research, bidding strategy, and creative. Optimize for CPL and CPA targets. A/B test ad copy and landing page experiences.
  2. Channel experimentation: Test new channels (Reddit, intent-based networks, and similar) where they fit the profile. Decide quickly whether to expand, optimize, or pause.
  3. Budget and bid management: Own channel-level budgets, bidding strategy, and daily optimization. Make recommendations on budget reallocation based on pipeline contribution.

HubSpot, CRM & Email

  1. Manage workflows, lists, forms, and campaign setup in HubSpot Marketing Hub.
  2. Build and run email nurture sequences; segment and personalize for different buyer stages.
  3. Own lead routing, field mapping, and data sync with sales. Keep CRM clean and lifecycle stages accurate.
  4. Manage email deliverability and compliance.

SEO, Technical Health & GEO/AIO Alignment

  • Review landing pages for technical SEO health (crawlability, indexation, page speed/Core Web Vitals, structured data, canonicalization, mobile-friendliness) before launch, flagging issues to the SEO/dev team.
  • Coordinate keyword strategy with the SEO agency to avoid paid/organic cannibalization and identify high-intent gaps paid search should fill.
  • Factor GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AIO (AI-search visibility) trends into landing page structure, content briefs, and campaign targeting so paid efforts stay aligned with how AI search surfaces answers.

Analytics & Reporting

  1. Build dashboards and weekly/monthly reports that show what’s working and what isn’t. Focus on pipeline metrics: CPL, CPA, funnel conversion, and revenue attribution.
  2. Use GA4, HubSpot, and channel analytics to diagnose problems and recommend optimizations.
  3. Track ABM campaign performance at the account level: reach, engagement, and pipeline influence.

Required (Core Competencies)

  1. 4–7 years in B2B performance or demand generation marketing.
  2. Deep hands-on experience with ABM: You’ve built account lists, created audience segments, run LinkedIn account-based campaigns, and measured account-level pipeline impact.
  3. LinkedIn proficiency: Expert in LinkedIn Campaign Manager and comfortable with LinkedIn Sales Navigator for research and targeting.
  4. Google Ads expertise: Google Ads certification or equivalent hands-on experience across Search, Display, and Performance Max.
  5. HubSpot (or similar) proficiency: Comfortable building workflows, forms, and campaigns in HubSpot Marketing Hub or a similar marketing automation platform without relying on support.
  6. Technical SEO know-how: Comfortable with crawlability, indexation, site speed, structured data, and landing page technical health enough to troubleshoot issues and work cross-functionally with the SEO team.
  7. GEO/AIO awareness: Understands how Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI-search visibility (AIO) reshaping search behavior are, and can apply this to landing page structure, content briefs, and campaign targeting.
  8. Analytics mindset: Comfortable with GA4, Looker Studio, and Excel/Sheets. You own pipeline metrics (CPL, CPA, funnel conversion) and make optimization decisions based on data.
  9. Organized and self-driven: You juggle multiple campaigns, set your own priorities, and follow through without constant oversight.

Title and Summary

Senior Software Engineer

Overview:
The Mastercard Developer Workbench, part of the MSBX (Mastercard Software Builder Experience) division, is evolving from a cost-allocation construct into a unified, developer-centric platform. With over 11,500 software engineers across the organization, Mastercard is investing in a dedicated product team to deliver an integrated, end-to-end developer experience.

The Developer Workbench brings together five core MSBX products - BuildersHub, DevFlow, TestFlow, DevInsights, and Cloud DevEx - alongside cross-cutting tools including GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Docker Desktop. This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of how engineers at one of the worlds leading technology companies build, test, and ship software.

About the Role:
- Design, build, and maintain core components of the Developer Workbench platform across the full development lifecycle.
- Contribute to the technical direction and roadmap of the Developer Workbench, helping evolve it from a chargeback mechanism into a cohesive, productized developer experience.
- Drive the integration and enablement of software engineering tools across the development lifecycle, with a focus on usability and reliability.
- Contribute to the governance of the "birthright and optional tooling" catalogue - supporting version lifecycle management, tool evaluations, and deprecation of redundant solutions.
- Collaborate with product owners, platform teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver workbench capabilities that align with organization-wide engineering priorities.
- Build and improve developer enablement features - onboarding flows, self-service tooling, feedback integrations - to maximize the value of deployed tools across 11,500+ engineers.
- Design and implement pre-provisioned onboarding environments that enable new hires to be productive within 30 minutes of day one.
- Implement and advance AI-augmented development capabilities including agentic coding tools, code assistants, and automated quality
pipelines.
- Instrument the platform with meaningful metrics that surface developer productivity, satisfaction, and platform health.
- Engage across engineering, security, and compliance teams to ensure tooling implementations meet Mastercards security and regulatory requirements.
- Actively participate in the Software Engineering Guild, sharing technical expertise and promoting standard engineering patterns across
the organization.

All About You:
- Strong background in software engineering, ideally including work on platform engineering, developer tooling, or developer experience (DevEx) products.
- Hands-on experience building and operating developer platforms or internal tooling at enterprise scale.
- Deep familiarity with the modern developer tooling ecosystem, including:
- AI coding assistants: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar
- Containerization and desktop dev environments: Docker Desktop, Kubernetes, DevContainers
- CI/CD and pipeline tooling: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar
- Developer portals and inner-source platforms: Backstage, or similar
- Experience working with AI-powered developer tools in a regulated enterprise environment, including an understanding of policy compliance, access controls, and responsible AI usage.
- Strong understanding of developer experience (DevEx) principles and the ability to translate developer pain points into platform improvements.
- Experience designing and delivering pre-provisioned, standardized development environments at scale.
- Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including infrastructure automation and cloud-native development patterns.
- Ability to contribute to tool adoption through instrumentation, metrics, and feedback mechanisms.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and cross-functional
teams.
- Familiarity with software development productivity metrics (e.g., DORA metrics, onboarding time, tool adoption rates) and using data to
inform technical decisions.
- Self-driven and comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-evolving technology environments.
- Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and SDLC best practices from design through deployment.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard s guidelines.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer will design, develop, support, and continuously enhance digital solutions across Lilly's global manufacturing network, while serving as the owner for one or more digital products developed by the DME team. Representative solutions in scope span the four pillars of the Engineering Digital Strategy and include - but are not limited to - the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, RCA and troubleshooting solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, capital project and qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, and inspection-readiness data products. These solutions are developed on standard Digital Engineering Platforms supported by the DME team, and the engineer will partner with data leads to ensure the necessary IT, OT, and ET data is available to support each solution. The engineer is also expected to leverage AI tools and platforms - such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropics Claude - to accelerate development and to embed AI capability into solutions, including building agent skills, prompt-based workflows, and retrieval/automation patterns on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms. This role is not focused on training or developing foundation models; it is focused on applying AI tools effectively and responsibly to manufacturing problems. This is a global role, supporting functional initiatives and all Lilly Manufacturing sites globally.

Role Context / Operating Model

This role operates within an evolved Digital Solutions Engineering operating model. The team includes a Rapid Innovation branch that works at speed to prototype concepts and proof-of-value solutions against key business problems surfaced from the manufacturing network. The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer takes ownership of those solutions once they have been validated as worth scaling - maturing them from prototype to production-grade, hardening them for validated-system and data-integrity requirements, deploying and supporting them across sites, and providing long-term ownership over their roadmap, enhancement, and lifecycle. This split lets the Rapid Innovation branch stay focused on speed and discovery while the Principal Digital Solutions Engineer ensures that the most valuable concepts become durable, well-supported solutions that scale across the global manufacturing network.

Primary Focus

The primary focus of the role is twofold. First, to develop and continuously enhance high-quality digital solutions that deliver measurable value to manufacturing operations - improving productivity, data integrity and compliance, quality, and operational excellence. Second, to assume the role of owner for those solutions: defining the product roadmap, managing the backlog, owning the technical architecture and lifecycle, ensuring compliance with validated-system requirements, and providing direct technical support to global users across Lilly Manufacturing. The engineer will work under guidance of the Digital Program Lead and partner closely with site engineers, network engineering organizations, and IT/OT platform owners to ensure each solution remains fit-for-purpose as the network and the underlying technology landscape evolve.

Key Objectives / Deliverables

  • Develop and continuously enhance digital solutions in support of the Engineering Digital Strategy for Manufacturing and Quality across its four pillars: Asset Delivery Qualification, Asset Performance/Maintenance Reliability, Engineering Fundamentals, and Training Knowledge Management.
  • Build and own solutions across a broad portfolio that may include: the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, RCA and troubleshooting tools, capital project and equipment qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, change-management assistants, and inspection-readiness data products.
  • Serve as owner for one or more DME-developed digital products, including ownership of the product roadmap, backlog, technical architecture, and full lifecycle from build through sustained operation.
  • Partner with the Rapid Innovation branch of the Digital Solutions Engineering team to take in validated prototypes and proof-of-value solutions, then mature them into production-grade, validated, scalable solutions ready for global deployment.
  • Lead the deployment of solutions across Lilly Manufacturing sites - including site onboarding, configuration, change management, training, and stand-up of ongoing support.
  • Provide direct technical support for owned solutions across the global manufacturing network - triaging issues, performing root cause analysis, delivering fixes, and managing the change and release process to keep solutions reliable and validated.
  • Drive continuous enhancement of solutions in production, prioritizing improvements based on user feedback, operational data, evolving site needs, and emerging technology capabilities.
  • Leverage AI tools and platforms - such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropics Claude - to accelerate solution development, automate routine engineering tasks, and embed AI capability into DME solutions. This includes building agent skills, prompts, retrieval-augmented patterns, and automated workflows on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms; it does not include training or developing foundation models.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools and patterns and integrate them responsibly into DME solutions, in alignment with Lillys AI governance, data integrity, and validated-system requirements.
  • Write, review, and maintain production-quality Python code that powers DME digital solutions; establish and uphold development standards, code review practices, and version control discipline.
  • Build analytics, monitoring, and visualization capabilities using Seeq and Power BI to surface manufacturing insights to engineers, operators, and leadership.
  • Partner with data leads within DME to define and provide the IT, OT, and ET data requirements needed to support each solution, and ensure data flows are reliable, governed, and fit-for-purpose.
  • Ensure all solutions are designed, operated, and enhanced in accordance with validated-system, data-integrity, and GMP requirements, and develop and implement the associated technical requirements and documentation.
  • Develop proof-of-concept solutions to explore new concepts within the Engineering Digital Strategy and progress them toward production

  • Build rich data visualizations using D3.js, Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG/Canvas components

  • Create reusable, well-documented component libraries with design system integration (Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules)
  • Optimize frontend performance: code splitting, lazy loading, memoisation, virtual scrolling, bundle analysis
  • Write comprehensive tests using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress for E2E testing
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, or polling strategies

API Design Backend Development

  • Design and build RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express/Fastify) or Python (FastAPI/Flask) following OpenAPI specifications
  • Develop GraphQL APIs where appropriate for complex data querying needs
  • Implement authentication and authorization (OAuth 2.0, JWT, RBAC) for secure API access
  • Build middleware for logging, rate limiting, caching, error handling, and request validation
  • Design database schemas and write efficient queries (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar)
  • Implement API versioning, pagination, filtering, and search capabilities
  • Build and maintain microservices or serverless functions (Azure Functions / AWS Lambda)
  • Create API documentation using Swagger/OpenAPI and maintain developer-facing docs

Integration Data Layer

  • Integrate frontend applications with data platforms (Databricks, data warehouses, data lakes) through API layers
  • Build data ingestion endpoints that accept, validate, transform, and store incoming data
  • Work with data engineers to consume curated datasets and serve them through optimized APIs
  • Implement caching strategies (Redis, CDN, browser cache) for high-performance data delivery
  • Connect to third-party services and APIs (payment gateways, CRM, loyalty platforms, analytics tools)

AI / LLM Integration

  • Build conversational AI interfaces (chatbots, knowledge agents) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)
  • Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns for document QA and contextual search
  • Create prompt engineering frameworks and manage AI response streaming in React UIs

DevOps Delivery

  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
  • Containerize applications with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes or cloud-managed services
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability (Datadog, New Relic, or Application Insights)
  • Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and drive engineering best practices

Must have skills

  • 57 years of professional full stack development experience in a product engineering environment
  • Expert-level React.js (4+ years): hooks, context, suspense, server components, performance patterns
  • Strong TypeScript proficiency type-safe component development, generics, utility types
  • Production experience building and consuming REST APIs (Node.js with Express/Fastify or Python with FastAPI)
  • Solid database skills: PostgreSQL or MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and/or MongoDB
  • Experience with modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, or Styled Components for scalable styling
  • Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, PR workflows, and collaborative development
  • Experience with cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) or AWS app hosting, serverless, storage, CDN
  • Strong understanding of web security: CORS, XSS, CSRF, CSP, authentication flows
  • Experience with Docker containerization and basic Kubernetes or cloud-managed container services
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and working in cross-functional, distributed teams

Good to have skills

  • Experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR, API routes) or Remix
  • GraphQL development experience (Apollo Server/Client or similar)
  • Data visualization expertise: D3.js, Recharts, Plotly, custom charting
  • Experience integrating with LLM/AI APIs and building AI-powered features
  • Knowledge of Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake/warehouse concepts
  • Experience with real-time systems: WebSockets, Kafka consumers, event-driven architecture
  • Familiarity with design tools (Figma) and design-to-code workflows
  • Understanding of retail / e-commerce domain (POS, loyalty, customer analytics)
  • Experience with Storybook for component documentation and visual testing
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and internationalization (i18n)

Education

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Relevant certifications are a plus: AWS/Azure Developer, Meta React Certification, or similar

Function: AI-LLM Project Delivery

Role Type: Individual Contributor – Mid-Level

Location: [Location / Hybrid / Remote]

Reports To: Delivery Unit Head


Works Closely With: Technical Product Managers, ML Engineers, SMEs, Quality Teams, Project Managers, Engineering Teams and AI Researchers


Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Product Manager to join our AI/LLM Delivery Unit, responsible for designing, developing, and delivering data-driven and AI-powered solutions for enterprise clients. This role combines strong analytical expertise, machine learning experience, and hands-on exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) to support high-impact client engagements.

The ideal candidate will be both technically strong and client-facing, capable of translating business requirements into scalable AI solutions.


Key Responsibilities


1. AI / Machine Learning Development

  • Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and data science solutions
  • Work on LLM-based use cases such as prompt engineering, evaluation, fine-tuning, and model optimization
  • Build and optimize pipelines for structured and unstructured data

2. LLM & Generative AI Solutions

  • Develop and evaluate applications using LLMs (e.g., text generation, classification, summarization, entity extraction)
  • Conduct prompt engineering and experimentation to improve model outputs
  • Support model benchmarking, testing, and performance evaluation

3. Data Analysis & Insights

  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and patterns
  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and feature engineering
  • Build data visualizations and reports for stakeholders

4. Client Engagement / Delivery

  • Participate in client-facing technical discussions and presentations
  • Translate business requirements into AI/ML solutions and solution architectures
  • Provide consultative insights based on project learnings and industry trends

5. Collaboration & Delivery Excellence

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (engineering, QA, annotation, delivery leads)
  • Support end-to-end project lifecycle: requirement gathering development deployment monitoring
  • Ensure quality, scalability, and reliability of AI deliverables

Qualifications


Education

  • Master’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field
  • Master’s degree or PhD preferred, especially for advanced AI/ML roles

Experience

  • 2–6+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or AI solutions
  • Experience working on AI/LLM or NLP-related projects is highly preferred
  • Exposure to client-facing or delivery environments is a strong advantage

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn)
  • Experience with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch)
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs / NLP tools (e.g., Hugging Face, OpenAI APIs, embeddings, RAG frameworks)
  • Support evaluation and benchmarking methodologies used to determine dataset quality and model performance.
  • Work with Subject Matter Experts, Quality teams, and Technical Product Managers to investigate potential data or Ground Truth issues.
  • Solid understanding of:
  • Machine learning algorithms
  • Data preprocessing and feature engineering
  • Model evaluation and performance metrics
  • Experience with:
  • SQL and large-scale datasets
  • Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Version control (Git)
  • Strong hands-on programming capability in Python.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • High attention to detail and quality
  • Collaborative mindset and adaptability in fast-paced environments

jobDescription:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer
Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
Must have skills : SAP ABAP Development for HANA
Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required
Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education
Summary
AI Powered Tech Talent
Build AI native, HANA optimized SAP applications and extensions by combining deep ABAP on HANA engineering with agentic AI patterns (LLMs + tools + retrieval + evaluation). The role focuses on delivering high performance, cloud ready, production-grade solutions using HANA pushdown principles, modern ABAP, and governed AI capabilities that can reason, retrieve context, and assist or act within enterprise SAP workflowswithout training foundation models from scratch.
Core Responsibilities
1) ABAP on HANA Engineering (Performance First)
Design and develop ABAP solutions optimized for SAP HANA using pushdown principles (minimize data movement, maximize in database processing).
Build efficient data models and access patterns using CDS views, associations, annotations, and authorization concepts.
Implement performance critical logic using AMDP / SQLScript where appropriate, with careful governance and testing.
2) Modern ABAP Development & Clean Design
Develop modular, testable, and maintainable ABAP code aligned to clean architecture practices and enterprise SDLC.
Build services and APIs using modern paradigms (OData/service exposure patterns), ensuring stability, versioning, and contract-first behavior.
Apply secure coding standards and authorization checks consistently across data and service layers.
3) Data Modeling, Reporting & Semantic Enablement
Model enterprise business entities using CDS semantics to support both transactional and analytical consumption.
Design reusable data artifacts that support downstream consumers (UI, integrations, analytics, and AI retrieval layers).
Ensure lineage-friendly structures and consistent business definitions to reduce ambiguity across systems.
4) AI Native SAP Capabilities (Agentic + Grounded)
Build AI enabled SAP experiences that integrate ABAP services with LLM capabilities, including:
o Tool calling orchestration (LLM triggers approved SAP actions via controlled APIs)
o Retrieval grounded outputs (RAG style grounding) over governed SAP data and documentation
o Deterministic fallbacks when grounding is weak or confidence is low
Implement prompts/templates, tool schemas, and context assembly strategies that reduce hallucinations and enforce enterprise safety boundaries.
5) Quality Engineering & Evaluation Loops (AI + ABAP)
Build automated tests (unit/integration/contract) for ABAP services and data artifacts enforce regression coverage for performance and correctness.
Establish evaluation harnesses for AI behaviors: offline golden datasets, scenario-based tests, and online monitoring to detect drift/regressions.
Introduce guardrails for AI outputs: authorization-aware context filtering, redaction rules, action confirmations, and audit logs.
6) Observability, Reliability & Operations
Instrument services and critical logic with logs/metrics/traces suitable for production support and root-cause analysis.
Design robust error handling for enterprise flows: retries, idempotency, correlation IDs, and safe failure modes.
Support incident response with runbooks and structured diagnostics continuously harden solutions based on observed failure patterns.
7) Integration & End to End Delivery
Integrate ABAP on HANA services with SAP and non SAP ecosystems (event-driven patterns, API gateways, enterprise integration layers).
Collaborate with UX, integration, data, and platform teams to ensure end to end solution correctness and performance.
Prototype rapidly, demonstrate frequently, and evolve prototypes into scalable production systems with security and compliance baked in.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
Strong hands on expertise in ABAP Development on HANA (performance tuning, pushdown, efficient SQL access patterns).
Proficiency with CDS views and modern data modeling practices (associations, annotations, authorization concepts).
Experience with AMDP / SQLScript for performance critical scenarios and controlled code pushdown.
Solid software engineering discipline: clean design, testing mindset, CI/CD orientation, and production readiness.
AI native build capability: LLM integration, retrieval grounding, tool orchestration, evaluation loops, and safety boundaries.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
OData/service design patterns, API lifecycle management, and contract-first development.
Experience integrating SAP backends with cloud runtimes and enterprise integration platforms.
Familiarity with performance benchmarking, load testing, and query-plan driven tuning practices.
Knowledge of SAP security/authorizations and compliance requirements for sensitive enterprise data.

What This Role Does Not Center On
Training or fine tuning foundation models from scratch.
AI assisted only development this role builds and owns AI behaviors (grounding, evaluation, guardrails, observability) as part of SAP solution delivery.

Value Delivered
High performance SAP solutions through HANA optimized ABAP engineering and disciplined pushdown design.
Faster delivery of intelligent SAP workflows via agentic AI patterns that are grounded, governed, and measurable.
Reduced operational risk through automated testing, observability, and robust safety boundaries for AI-enabled actions.
Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required Role & responsibilities

jobDescription:
Role :Generative AI / Agentic AI Engineer

Location: Ahmedabad, Indore, Pune

Looking for 0-30 days Joiner


Role summary:

  • Mininum 3 years of focused Experience on designing, building, and deploying production-grade generative AI and agentic-AI solutions.
  • Responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and business-oriented AI systems that operate on structured and unstructured data and enable AI-driven decision-making

Required experience

  • 4 6 years of industry experience in software engineering and AI-related roles.
  • Minimum 2-3 years of direct experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect, develop, test, and deploy generative-AI solutions (online/offline LLMs, SLMs, TLMs) for domain-specific use cases.
  • Design and implement agentic AI workflows and orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, Crew AI, or equivalent.
  • Integrate enterprise knowledge bases and external data sources via vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Build and productionize ingestion, preprocessing, indexing, and retrieval pipelines for structured and unstructured data (text, tables, documents, images).
  • Implement fine-tuning, prompt engineering, evaluation metrics, A/B testing, and iterative model improvement cycles.
  • Conduct/model red-teaming and vulnerability assessments of LLMs and chat systems using tools like Garak (Generative AI Red-teaming & Assessment Kit).
  • Collaborate with MLOps/platform teams to containerize, monitor, version, and scale models (CI/CD, model registry, observability).
  • Ensure model safety, bias mitigation, access controls, and data privacy compliance in deployed solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into technical designs with clear performance, cost, and safety constraints.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with ML/AI libraries (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face ecosystem).
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines.
  • Practical experience deploying agentic workflows and building multi-step, tool-enabled agents.
  • Experience using Garak (or similar LLM red-teaming/vulnerability scanners) to identify model weaknesses and harden deployments.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing content filtering / moderation systems.
  • Solid skills working with structured and unstructured data and advanced feature engineering.
  • Familiarity with cloud GenAI platforms and services (Azure AI Services preferred; AWS/GCP acceptable).
  • Experience building APIs/microservices; containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of model evaluation, performance profiling, inference cost optimization, and observability.
  • Good knowledge of security, data governance, and privacy best practices for AI systems.

Preferred / differentiating qualifications

  • Hands-on fine-tuning experience and parameter-efficient tuning methods.
  • Experience with multimodal models and retrieval-augmented multimodal pipelines.
  • Prior work on agentic safety, tool-use constraints, LLM application firewalls, or human-in-the-loop systems.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, Crew AI, or similar orchestration libraries.

Values & behaviours

  • AI-first thinking: consistently seeks AI-enabled solutions to business problems.
  • Data-driven mindset: makes decisions based on measurable insights and metrics.
  • Collaboration & agility: effective contributor in cross-functional, fast-paced teams.
  • Problem-solving orientation: looks beyond the obvious to unlock product and business value.
  • Business impact focus: designs solutions with measurable outcomes and real adoption.
  • Continuous learning: stays current with academic research, open-source tooling, and best practices.

  • Support implementation of new and existing standards, processes, and best practices across data engineering and analytics platforms.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute insights on emerging data technologies, tools, and industry trends.
  • Perform in-depth data analysis, data modeling, and data design activities to support business and analytics needs.

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in self-service and analytics platforms including Denodo, Dataiku and Power BI.
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms (Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock) for designing and developing intelligent agents and workflow automation.
  • Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field from an accredited institution.
  • Hands-on experience or internships in data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, or business intelligence.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear, business-oriented terms.
  • Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics principles, including data modeling, ingestion, transformation, and semantic layer design.
  • Basic exposure to advanced analytics concepts such as predictive analytics, data mining, or statistical analysis is a plus.
  • Understanding data storage and processing technologies including relational databases, columnar databases, Hadoop or Hive-based platforms.
  • Strong experience in data modeling concepts and tools such as ERwin or ER Studio.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with technologies such as Spark, HiveSQL, Python, R, Sqoop, and JDBC or ODBC connectivity.
  • Understanding data visualization best practices and storytelling through dashboards and reports.
Desired Characteristics
  • Experience working on IT or data projects in collaborative, cross-functional teams.
  • Exposure to information systems design, implementation, or operational support.
  • Familiarity with application development or data platform development concepts.
  • Experience or exposure to data technologies such as Hive, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Hadoop, or NoSQL platforms.
  • Experience with metadata management, data cataloging, or data lineage tools is a plus.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and cloud data strategies is a plus.
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and customer-focused approach.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with clear and structured communication.
  • Ability to anticipate challenges and proactively develop mitigation plans.

Job Summary
The Product Definition Engineering (PDE) team has an exciting engineering opportunity for candidates who are passionate about growing their careers in Computer-Aided Design (CAD). The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in product design and drafting using Siemens NX CAD tool, along with a good understanding of ASME Y14.5 standards.
Responsibilities
  • Perform product design and drafting activities for engine and locomotive components using Siemens NX CAD tool.
  • Develop detailed manufacturing drawings in compliance with ASME Y14.5 and ISO standards.
  • Manage and execute Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) and Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) within the Teamcenter environment (TCE).
  • Work independently with cross-functional engineering and manufacturing teams to gather requirements and resolve design-related issues.
  • Continuously build and expand technical expertise in the engine and locomotive domain.
Qualifications/Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech.) in Mechanical Engineering with a strong academic record.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in product design and drafting using the Siemens NX (Unigraphics NX) CAD tool.
  • Good knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GDT) in accordance with ASME Y14.5 and ISO standards.

About us

We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You'll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There's no one like you and that's why there's nowhere like RSM.

  • Senior Associate ERP Quality Engineering (Manual Automated Testing)

Position Summary


The Senior Associate will be responsible for planning, designing, executing, and automating testing activities for large-scale ERP and digital transformation programs. The role requires a strong blend of functional ERP testing expertise, test management, and automation capabilities to ensure high-quality software delivery across complex enterprise environments.


Key Responsibilities

Functional Manual Testing

  • Perform end-to-end testing for ERP implementations and transformation programs involving Microsoft Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, and related enterprise platforms.
  • Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and process flows to design comprehensive test plans and test scenarios.
  • Create detailed test cases, test scripts, test data, and traceability matrices from high-level requirements.
  • Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.
  • Validate complex business processes including:
    • Order to Cash (O2C)
    • Procure to Pay (P2P)
    • Record to Report (R2R)
    • Lead to Cash (L2C)
    • Supply Chain and Warehouse Operations

  • Identify, document, and track defects through resolution using established defect management processes.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and development teams to ensure solution quality.

Test Automation

  • Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites using both codeless and code-based automation frameworks.
  • Build automation solutions using tools such as:
    • Leapwork
    • Playwright

  • Enhance and optimize automation frameworks to improve coverage, maintainability, and execution efficiency.
  • Analyze automation execution results and provide recommendations for quality improvements.
  • Support regression testing strategies through automation-first approaches.
  • Utilize AI to help develop automated test suites.

Test Management Quality Engineering

  • Utilize test management tools including:
    • Azure DevOps
    • Jira

  • Create and manage test plans, test suites, test cycles, and defect workflows.
  • Prepare testing metrics, status reports, defect trends, and quality dashboards.
  • Participate in test estimation, planning, and risk assessment activities.
  • Support test environment management and release validation activities.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing practices.



Required Qualifications

  • 3-6+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and Testing.
  • Strong experience in both manual testing and automation testing.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP platforms such as Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or Salesforce.
  • Experience creating detailed test scenarios and scripts from business requirements.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools.
  • Understanding of SDLC, Agile, and DevOps.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ERP business process testing (O2C, P2P, R2R, L2C).
  • Experience with API testing and integration testing.
  • Exposure to performance testing concepts and tools.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted testing tools and techniques to improve test design, test data generation, test automation development, defect analysis, and overall testing efficiency.
  • Familiarity with generative AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools for accelerating test case creation, automation script development, and quality engineering activities.
  • Exposure to testing AI-enabled applications and generative AI solutions, including validation of AI outputs for accuracy, consistency, reliability, security, and responsible AI principles. Familiarity with common AI quality risks such as hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, non-deterministic responses, bias, data grounding issues, explainability, and model drift is preferred.

Success Profile


The ideal candidate is a quality engineering professional who can independently execute manual testing activities, drive automation initiatives, collaborate with business and technical teams, and contribute to high-quality ERP implementations through both functional expertise and automation excellence.

title: AI Prompt Engineer

jobDescription:
About the role

Prompting is engineering here, not trial and error. You will own the prompt and evaluation layer of real AI products: agents, retrieval pipelines and in-product copilots that run against live traffic. The job is to make model behaviour measurable and repeatable, so the team can change a model or a prompt and know, with numbers, whether the system got better or worse.

What you will do
  • Design, version and test prompts for production agents, RAG systems and copilots, and document why each change moved the metric.
  • Build evaluation suites that catch regressions before users do, with graded test sets and clear pass and fail thresholds.
  • Tune retrieval and context assembly so the model gets the right information, not just more of it.
  • Write guardrails and fallbacks for the cases that break a demo: refusals, hallucinations, jailbreaks and long-tail inputs.
  • Work with the engineers serving the model on latency, cost-per-call and token budgets, the numbers Production-First AI locks first.
  • Turn what you learn into reusable prompt patterns and eval templates the wider AI practice can pick up.
What we are looking for
  • 2 to 5 years working with LLMs in a hands-on role, with shipped or near-shipped features you can talk through.
  • Strong Python, and comfort reading and writing code around an API rather than only using a playground.
  • A real understanding of evaluation: you can explain how you would prove a prompt change is an improvement, not a vibe.
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings and vector search, and the failure modes each one brings.
  • Precise written reasoning, since most of this job is making model behaviour legible to other engineers.
Nice to have
  • Experience with eval tooling such as Ragas or Braintrust, and tracing tools for agent runs.
  • Hands-on time with LangGraph or a similar orchestration framework.
  • A background in linguistics, applied ML or data science.
What we offer
  • Real production problems against live traffic, not prompt demos that never deploy.
  • A method built around evaluation, so your work is measured by numbers rather than opinion.
  • Senior AI engineers to build with and a bench that has carried AI to production since the shift in 2026.
  • A hybrid seat at our Noida delivery center.

**Kindly review the JD before Applying****




About the Role


We are building an enterprise agentic AI platform that serves as the automation backbone across three healthcare RCM product lines Artemis (ABA therapy management), Olympus.


This platform replaces traditional RPA with intelligent agents that reason, adapt, and self-heal combining deterministic automation with LLM-powered decision-making for healthcare workflows.

You will be a core member of the platform team, responsible for building reusable agent workflows, MCP tool integrations, and the LLM reasoning layer that powers denial management, payer intelligence, document processing, and browser automation across all products.


This is not a chatbot or copilot role. You will be building production agents that process healthcare claims, interact with payer portals, generate appeal letters, parse EDI transactions, and make decisions that directly impact revenue recovery. The work requires equal comfort with infrastructure-level Python, LLM prompt engineering, and healthcare domain understanding.


What You Will Work On


Agent Development & Orchestration

  • Design and build agentic workflows using LangGraph for complex, multi-step healthcare processes denial management pipelines, eligibility verification chains, prior authorization workflows
  • Implement the 4-tier cost architecture: deterministic scripts (Tier 1), LLM fallback for self-healing (Tier 2), cached AI navigation (Tier 3), and full reasoning agents (Tier 4)
  • Build multi-agent systems where specialized agents (claim analyzer, appeal writer, payer policy checker) collaborate through structured handoffs
  • Integrate agents with AWS Step Functions for durable, stateful execution of long-running workflows with human-in-the-loop approval gates

MCP Tool Development

  • Build reusable MCP (Model Context Protocol) server tools wrapping existing APIs — AdvancedMD, CollaborateMD, clearinghouse APIs (Waystar, Change Healthcare, Availity), payer portal integrations
  • Design the MCP tool library architecture so that every connector built for one product.
  • Implement custom MCP tools for healthcare-specific operations: EDI 835/837 parsing, CARC/RARC code lookup, CPT/ICD-10 reference queries, payer policy retrieval

Browser Automation

  • Build and maintain Playwright-based browser automation for healthcare portals (AdvancedMD, payer portals, clearinghouse portals)
  • Implement the LLM fallback self-healing pattern — deterministic Playwright as primary path, Claude Vision via Bedrock for automatic recovery when portal UI selectors break
  • Develop cached navigation plans for payer portals — LLM discovers navigation once, caches the plan, replays deterministically on subsequent runs
  • Integrate with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser Tool for managed, isolated browser sessions

Must-Have Skills


Python (Core)

  • 3+ years production Python — deployed services handling real workloads, not scripts or notebooks
  • Strong async Python (asyncio, aiohttp) — browser automation and agent loops are inherently async
  • Pydantic for data validation and structured outputs
  • Experience with at least one web automation framework: Playwright (strongly preferred), Selenium, or Puppeteer via Pyppeteer
  • Comfortable with Python packaging, dependency management, and writing maintainable code

AWS Services

  • Hands-on experience with at least 4 of: ECS Fargate, Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, Secrets Manager, Bedrock
  • Understanding of IAM policies, VPC networking, and security groups
  • Experience with CDK or CloudFormation for infrastructure-as-code (CDK TypeScript preferred given existing codebase)

LLM / AI Engineering

  • Practical experience building applications with LLM APIs — Claude (Anthropic), GPT (OpenAI), or equivalent
  • Understanding of prompt engineering patterns: ReAct (Reason + Act), chain-of-thought, few-shot examples, structured output extraction
  • Experience with at least one agent framework: LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or AutoGen
  • Understanding of RAG — vector embeddings, similarity search, knowledge base construction
  • Awareness of token economics — knowing when to use an LLM and when a regex or SQL query is the right answer

Software Engineering Fundamentals

  • Git workflows, code review practices, CI/CD pipelines
  • REST API design and consumption
  • PostgreSQL — complex queries, indexes, JSONB columns
  • Error handling for unreliable external systems (retry logic, circuit breakers, dead letter queues)
  • Structured logging, CloudWatch integration, distributed tracing concepts

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Healthcare RCM domain knowledge — EDI 837/835 formats, CARC/RARC denial codes, CPT/HCPCS coding, clearinghouse workflows, payer portal navigation
  • MCP (Model Context Protocol) — experience building MCP servers/tools or familiarity with the specification
  • Amazon Bedrock — AgentCore, Knowledge Bases, or model invocation via Bedrock Runtime API
  • LangGraph specifically — graph-based state machine design for multi-step agent workflows
  • Document AI — PDF extraction, OCR, table extraction from scanned documents
  • HIPAA compliance awareness — PHI handling, encryption requirements, audit trail needs
  • Playwright MCP server for browser automation via AI agents
  • Voice/telephony integration — Twilio, Deepgram, ElevenLabs (relevant for Olympus voice bot)
  • Prior experience replacing or working alongside RPA tools (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism)

What We Are NOT Looking For


  • Pure data scientists or ML researchers — this is an engineering role, not a modeling role. We use frontier LLMs via API, we don’t train models.
  • Chatbot/copilot builders — our agents take real actions on production systems (submit claims, navigate portals, post payments). This requires a production engineering mindset, not a demo mindset.
  • Framework tourists — we need people who can evaluate when to use LangGraph vs a simple Python function, when to use an LLM vs a regex, when to use an agent vs a cron job. Tool selection judgment matters more than tool familiarity.

VELLOEs journey began with a clear thesis: Built by operators. Powered by intelligence. We are an independent infrastructure intelligence company operating at the intersection of operations, AI execution, and enterprise transformation. Founded by people who understand how fast-moving environments actually work, VELLOE combines operator expertise, AI-enabled workflows, and precise execution across critical infrastructure environments. Rather than advising from the outside like a traditional consultancy, our teams embed directly into the operation to deliver clarity at the edge of complexity. If you enjoy working in a hyper-fast-growing company, are eager to be part of an agile team, and want to be part of our success story, then lets talk!

Impact at VELLOE

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will drive the design, development, and deployment of scalable, enterprise-grade web applications. You will be a hands-on technical contributor responsible for building robust, high-performance systems that combine modern full-stack engineering with applied Generative AI capabilities, ensuring reliable, production-ready solutions for our clients.

Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Design, Build & Deploy: Design, develop, and deploy scalable, enterprise-grade web applications end to end.
  • Engineer the Core Stack: Build and maintain applications primarily using Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL.
  • Extend the Ecosystem: Apply Python and Go (Golang) alongside Redis and Apache Kafka to support performant, event-driven services.
  • Build AI-Powered Features: Develop Generative AI capabilities, including LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, and AI Agents, as part of application functionality.
  • Architect Microservices: Build microservices, REST APIs, and cloud-native, distributed applications.
  • Apply Strong Fundamentals: Use Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures, Algorithms, and Design Patterns to write clean, maintainable code.
  • Optimize Performance: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and contribute to scalable system design and architecture.
  • Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with cross-functional teams, debug complex issues, and mentor other developers.

Required Qualifications

The top candidate will have:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of professional experience in full-stack development with a proven track record of building scalable, high-performance, and AI-powered software solutions.
  • Strong expertise in Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL (mandatory).
  • Hands-on experience with Python, Go (Golang), Redis, and Apache Kafka.
  • Practical experience with Generative AI, including LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, or AI application development.
  • Experience building microservices, REST APIs, and cloud-native, distributed applications.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures, Algorithms, and Design Patterns.
  • Experience with application performance optimization, scalable system design, and modern software architecture.
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

    Production experience in all five core technologies is strictly mandatory for candidate evaluation and shortlisting:
    Node.js

    Golang

Bonus Qualifications

Ideally you have:

  • Exposure to building or deploying AI Agents in production environments.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, structured Agile delivery environments.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or technical writing.

Ideal Candidate

  • A strong hands-on engineer who is equally comfortable across the frontend, backend, and data layer.
